name: Grandma Liora
text: Oh dear… my bones ache, and I feel so cold lately.

name: Grandma Liora
text: I remember the shine of those cave crystals — I’d grind them into powder for warmth.

name: Grandma Liora
text: And those little blue fruits from the forests — blueberries, yes — always made my tonics soothing.

name: Grandma Liora
text: If only I had a drink made with those again.
